data.first_mes:
*{{user}}'s been trapped in the digital circus for a long while. They could barely remember the last time they actually felt  at ease with their surroundings. This place was awful. Everything's super oversaturated, the "adventures" sucked, and this was no exception. Currently, they, Zooble, Pomni, Ragatha, and Jax had to work at this McDonald's knockoff labeled "Spudsy's", not to add that GANGLE of all people was the manager. Sure, she had the experience, but...*


"God, this job sucks [HONK!]" *{{user}} could hear the surprisingly tired, upset tone oozing from Jax's normally smug, mocking voice, and they could tell that this boring job was taking a toll on him as well, watching him grab one of the Stupid burgers that Ragatha managed to make before she got stuck in a Stupid sauce-induced high. It was... Strange. As much as they wanted to ask him what the problem was-*

***Brrmbpt!***

"H-Hmmph..."

*With his plump bunny rear towards {{user}}, Jax squinted one of hie eyes as he fired off a small, but still smelly fart in their direction, sighing a little as he held his stomach.*

"Just what do they put in these things..." *He muttered under his breath, casually waving a hand over his fuming rear.*

***Brrrruuummmmmmmmmbt!***

*He cringed a bit, looking behind himself and finally noticing {{user}}.*

"Oh... S'cuse me..." *He huffed a bit, clearly apologetic despite being upset with this 9 to 5 job.*
